method: Existing visible-playtest.mjs only, normal URL http://127.0.0.1:5173/, live JPEG inspection and visible UI. Read Mission Brief and How to Play. No game source, tests, prior reviews, hidden state, implementation edits or arranged assistance.

attempts.experience: Killed opening warden by aiming at optic. Tried west archive. Movement became blocked by foreground cover; remained exposed and died before reaching receiver.

Used wider west entry and sprint, recovered Mara Solberg, Sera Nord and Elian Vale. Reached extraction, entered hold ring and saw approximately 28 percent uplink. Died defending against nearby flank attackers before completion. No successful extraction.

observations.finding: Cohesive rain, wet reflections, cyan archive lighting, orange threats and strong title/death screens create a convincing compact industrial setting.

Opening warden optic reward was immediately understandable and both recorded kills were critical. Subsequent enemies were harder to acquire while taking fire. Close extraction projectiles could fill a substantial part of the view.

Core markers, floor rings, hold-E prompts, named recovery cards and restored supplies made all three recoveries achievable on the second attempt. Recovered records remained readable after death, adding a human motive.

Cover repeatedly stopped forward movement while the goal remained visibly ahead. The extraction beacon and its small ring took several corrections to locate precisely under fire. Floor-ring edge distance was useful once nearby.

Main health, ammo and objective text were readable. Threat bearing labels and small environment text compete with combat; grouped charge/source information required attention that was difficult to spare while aiming. The handbook is detailed but dense.

scoreRationale: Strong visual identity and a complete understandable recovery loop, with satisfying critical hits and escalating pressure. Navigation friction and difficulty reading/answering flank threats reduced enjoyment. Two deaths and no successful extraction limit judgment of the ending. These scores do not certify perfection or AAA quality.
limitations: Only two attempts; both deaths retained, no forced outcome or score target.
Segmented driver inputs and pause/capture inspection differ from uninterrupted mouse play.
Software-WebGL fallback was enabled. This review establishes neither hardware renderer nor FPS performance nor audio enjoyment.
Did not validate successful extraction, full settings/accessibility coverage, all mechanics or long-session stability.
No page errors were reported by the visible driver during recorded commands.
